## What this does

P33.3 consumes the two independent capstone inputs — P33.1's gap analysis
(`CAPSTONE_GAP_ANALYSIS.md` §(k)) and P33.2's composed-verification proof
(`COMPOSED_E2E_REPORT.md` addendum + `reports/p33.2-composed-verification/`,
`sig.composed-verification/1` pass 20/20) — and presents the **Round-10
acceptance packet** that GATE-ACCEPT (manifest row 195, HG-14) reviews. It
prepares; it does not sign.

- **`CAPSTONE_CLOSURE.md` §(f)** (appended; nothing historical rewritten):
  (f1) all **38 §55 requirement ids** with honest dispositions —
  **34 MET / 2 PARTIAL** (`SIG-EVAL-001/002`: machinery landed, zero human
  labels — `awaiting_humans`) / **4 MISSING** honestly recorded
  (`SIG-EVAL-005/006/007` wholesale-deferred owners under `D-R10-HUMAN-1`;
  `SIG-MEM-004` scheduled to P33.8 row 200); (f2) six cross-stream seams
  (4 MET / 1 PARTIAL / 1 MISSING-by-design); (f3) the dated verification
  matrix for this revision; (f4) the deviation/ADR register (ADR-120…144 +
  recorded in-ticket repairs — **no new ADR**, nothing undecided left);
  (f5) the **OPEN-obligation register** — every owed `DEFERRALS.md` row
  (36 = 32 OPEN + 4 PARTIAL) + `SIG-MEM-004`, each with owner, landing,
  closure condition, compensating control; (f6) honest scope state;
  (f7) the acceptance list — what a signature would mean.
- **18 dated P33.3 disposition annotations** in `DEFERRALS.md` — every
  Round-10-scoped obligation now records "stays OPEN: adjudicated and carried
  into the Round-10 acceptance register". No row closed without evidence;
  nothing opened.
- **New deterministic guard** `tests/unit/test_capstone_closure_round10.py`
  (7 tests): fails if the packet drops a §55 id, silently omits an owed row,
  names a phantom obligation, flips an annotation past OPEN/PARTIAL, or lets
  `ACCEPT-R10.md` leave PENDING unmarked.
- **`reports/current/` projection regenerated** — `verify` fresh
  (539 input digests, 0 known inconsistencies).
- **Build memory** — LEDGER advanced (`lastCompleted: P33.3`,
  `nextTicket: GATE-ACCEPT` — pending pause), PHASE LOG, BUILD_INDEX row 194,
  `runs/P33.3.md`, this body.

Two real engineering findings remain **OPEN by contract** (repair shape is a
maintainer decision — `db/AGENTS.md` forbids in-place edits of landed
deploy/revert/verify scripts, and the defects are invisible to the per-change
path `make check`/`make test-db` exercises):

- `D-P32.10a-1` — whole-plan `sqitch verify` still asserts 27 watermark facets

- `D-P32.16a-1` — whole-plan `sqitch revert` drops `postgis` without CASCADE

→ 11 false `open-vs-passed-gate` findings; re-worded to `ACCEPT-R10` and the
committed projection regenerated clean.
